Message:
ALSA: hda/realtek: Enable mute/micmute LEDs and speaker support for HP Laptops

On HP Laptops, requires the ALC245_FIXUP_CS35L41_SPI_2_HP_GPIO_LED quirk to
make its audio LEDs and speaker work.
